design_description: A refined royal blue design with subtle tonal striping that gives the jersey depth without overpowering the clean composition. The thin alternating blue panels create a classic football structure while keeping the look modern and understated. White-and-gold trim details on the collar and sleeve cuffs add an elegant premium touch that elevates the simplicity. The gold sponsor integration blends naturally into the palette, reinforcing the sophisticated club identity. Overall, the design feels traditional, balanced, and professional — a timeless European-style football kit.
